name: Layers · hidden — EDITOR-ONLY DIM — the eye writes data-hidden on the canvas node and nothing else; the element publishes unchanged. Its own tooltip says so: “Dim in editor — the element still publishes”. Hiding on the SITE is the Inspector’s Visibility section (useLayerActions.ts:126-146, LayerTreeItem.tsx:285-306)

Layers · locked — TWO SOURCES OF TRUTH — the padlock is drawn from a per-page localStorage set; the lock the canvas enforces is ElementData.locked on the document. Clicking writes both, the panel only ever re-reads storage, so a second machine draws an OPEN padlock over an element the canvas refuses (useLayerActions.ts:70-97,163-168; Element.ts:151-155; useSelectionBehavior.ts:88-95)

Layers · context-menu — SCOPE SPLIT — with five rows selected every item except Group acts on the ONE right-clicked row (useLayerContextActions.ts:16-19 vs :97-99), and Delete removes the element and every descendant with no confirm, no count and no toast (useLayerActions.ts:208-217)
